findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "bobai_links" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Official $BOBAI links: website, BscScan contract, X, Telegram, DexScreener, GeckoTerminal, CoinGecko, GitHub source, llms.txt." → after: "Official $BOBAI links: website, BscScan contract + verified source, X, Telegram, DexScreener, GeckoTerminal, CoinGecko, live burn audit log, llms.txt."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
